Entries: This file summarizes the consensus taxonomy for each metabarcoding sample per site per estuary along with the sum reads.    This file is derived by combining the Final_Matches-esv.data.csv and the Estuaries2022-MiFishU-metadata.csv. Note that these data include several estuaries in addition to Calleguas Creek

These data are used to estimate how well tidewater gobies are detected by metabarcoding (for comparison with qPCR). They are also used to estimate the plausible list of taxa detected by metabarcoding.
US Geological Survey, Western Ecological Research Center, c/o Marine Science Institute, University of California
Southern California Estuaries: Santa Barbara and Ventura Counties
